statements.impact_statement: The image's entrypoint /usr/local/bin/provider (upjet CLI mode) only executes /usr/local/bin/terraform (OpenTofu), which only executes the mirrored terraform-provider-archestra plugin; all three are static Go binaries (no PT_INTERP, no DT_NEEDED) that use Go's crypto/tls, so they never load libssl.so.3 or libcrypto.so.3. OpenSSL is linked only by apk (libapk), c_rehash and busybox's ssl_client, which no process in the image invokes.

OpenSSL is linked only by apk (libapk), c_rehash and busybox's ssl_client, which no process in the image invokes.

OpenSSL is linked only by apk (libapk), c_rehash and busybox's ssl_client, which no process in the image invokes.

The image's entrypoint /usr/local/bin/provider (upjet, fork mode) only executes /usr/local/bin/terraform, which only executes the mirrored terraform-provider-archestra plugin; all three are static Go binaries (CGO_ENABLED=0, no PT_INTERP or dynamic section) and do not use musl, so musl's regcomp() is never called by any process the image runs. musl is used only by the busybox, bash, apk and musl-utils programs, which nothing in the image invokes.

The flaw is in zlib's contrib/infback9 module (inftree9.c) as bundled by GDAL; Alpine's zlib package ships only /usr/lib/libz.so.1.3.2, which exports no inflateBack9* symbols, and no file in the image contains infback9 code.

The Zip Slip flaw is in go-slug's extraction path (Unpack / Packer.Unpack, fixed in internal/unpackinfo); the /usr/local/bin/terraform 1.5.7 binary links only go-slug's packing functions (Pack, Packer.Pack, ignore-rule parsing), and its Go function table contains no go-slug Unpack function.
